changes: Retain job.started_at as reported but use minimum actual executed-step start and maximum executed-step completion for the job execution interval.
Require completed executed-step timestamps; missing/invalid times mean unconfirmed. Skipped steps are not execution intervals.
Require zero-overlap checks for actual step intervals and both native-trial and outer-slot intervals; no tolerance added to overlap checks.
Retain the existing one-second timestamp-resolution allowance only for containment of outer slots inside whole-second API step boundaries.
At final execution pass an explicit --source-root for the new confirmation local c01 prepared task source.
reason: GitHub job-level started_at can be populated while a matrix job is still queued; it is not proof of actual execution start. This correction was made before reading final raw outputs.
